{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows early signs of decline.",
    "Reduce forecast peaks after sharp spikes — model tends to overshoot post-spikes, especially in late-summer/early-autumn.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if 3-5 consecutive days show high volatility or extreme values, dampen forecast momentum.",
    "For 30-day horizon, reduce forecast sensitivity to recent high values — model overreacts to recent highs.",
    "If sentiment is neutral (0.00) and price is trending downward, slightly lower forecast to avoid overcorrection.",
    "When true outcome is significantly below model forecast (e.g., >10% gap), reduce forecast by 5-15% to align with observed mean reversion.",
    "In late-autumn (post-2024-08-30), model tends to overestimate downward trend — apply downward bias of 3-8% for 30-day forecasts."
  ]
}
